hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the univariate template H(s)=V(s)*G0(s)*V(s) at s=p and at s=q. The displayed expression is the sum H(p)+H(q).
required_assumptions: V and G0 are unary functions defined at p and q.
hypotheses.rationale: Both summands are syntactically identical except for the substitution of the symbol p by q, so they are two specializations of the same parameterized product V(s)*G0(s)*V(s).
